name: home-share
description: Share files and text between phone and laptop over home Wi-Fi

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix web && npm install --prefix mobile && npm install --prefix desktop
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix web"
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build:web && npm run build:server && npm run start --prefix desktop
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:web && npm run build:server && npm run build:win --prefix desktop
scripts.build:all: npm run build:desktop && npm run build:apk
